summary: The PR publication change adds no injection, secret, authorization or dependency defect; its one remaining issue is that the Branch PR lookup has no --limit, so the same-repository filter runs on gh's default 30-entry window and fails closed.

findings.summary: ENG-24: the Branch PR lookup at step 9 item 3.1 sets no --limit, and the isCrossRepository filter is applied after gh has truncated the list, so a same-repository PR can fall outside the window.
findings.evidence: Line 159 has no --limit; gh 2.101.0 default limit 30; --head filters by branch name alone. With 30+ same-named fork entries the same-repository PR can be absent; creation is rejected as a duplicate and the run halts (fails closed). Item 4 lookup (line 164) can raise a false assignment problem. Same command pinned in DESIGN.md:233, contracts, data-model and the test LOOKUP constant.
findings.fix: Add --limit 100 to the lookup in SKILL.md items 3.1 and 4, mirror in DESIGN.md, contracts, data-model, and the test LOOKUP constant; keep the isCrossRepository filter.
